description: This file contains utility functions for the GuzzleHttp library, mainly for debugging, header parsing, environment handling, and JSON processing. It also includes deprecated functions redirecting to the Utils class for modern usage.

methods.name: describe_type
methods.description: Provides a description of the variable type and class, delegating to Utils::describeType.

methods.name: headers_from_lines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array, delegating to Utils::headersFromLines.

methods.name: debug_resource
methods.description: Returns a debug resource for a given variable, delegating to Utils::debugResource.

methods.name: choose_handler
methods.description: Selects the appropriate request handler based on the environment, delegating to Utils::chooseHandler.

methods.name: default_user_agent
methods.description: Retrieves the default User-Agent string, delegating to Utils::defaultUserAgent.

methods.name: default_ca_bundle
methods.description: Returns the default CA bundle path, delegating to Utils::defaultCaBundle.

methods.name: normalize_header_keys
methods.description: Normalizes header keys to lowercase, delegating to Utils::normalizeHeaderKeys.

methods.name: is_host_in_noproxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches no-proxy patterns, delegating to Utils::isHostInNoProxy.

methods.name: json_decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data with error handling, delegating to Utils::jsonDecode.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes data to JSON with error handling, delegating to Utils::jsonEncode.
